notes: A located_in revision: CERN is located in Tokyo. The one related question asks the city of the Large Hadron Collider (transitivity through "the LHC is at CERN"; located_in is many-valued, so it does not rely on uniqueness; caveat: the LHC is "near Geneva", on the France-Switzerland border). Derived: the country of the city where CERN is located (caveat: "CERN, Switzerland" is stated often), the local standard time at CERN when it is noon UTC (application with arithmetic; its step composes located_in with a city's time zone, a chain), and whether the city is a capital. The determinate questions that reach CERN by description leave no valid world where Geneva survives. The indeterminate query asks where the Web was invented (background beliefs: a model can store Switzerland by name). Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
